item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po'i nges don
item.coloph: rim gyis brgyud nas rang grol bla ma rgyal mtshan/ de la rko (ko) bo rtogs ldan/ drung pa zhu tshang rin chen rnam rgyal phyag dpe'o/ rim par brgyud nas/ mnyam med bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ a mchog lhun grub rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis char la tshab be nam mkha' ye shes/ drin can de'i drung du bdag khyung po mchog legs grags pas zhus/ zhu drung rin chen rgyal byed phyag dpe'i bkra shis so//
